summary: Tested Neon RPS dApp (Vite frontend + FastAPI->Node Express proxy backend). All 4 backend pytest checks PASSED. All 5 frontend pages load with HTTP 200 and render expected content. /game/1 stays in 'LOADING NEURAL LINK...' loading layout indefinitely (likely because game id=1 doesn't exist on Base mainnet contract yet, or on-chain read silently fails) - layout itself renders correctly. Console shows a few HTTP 413 (Payload Too Large) errors from external resources (likely WalletConnect verify/relay endpoints), but do not break the app. No JS crashes, all routes navigable, footer + contract addresses present everywhere required.

integration_issues.issue: Page stays in 'LOADING NEURAL LINK...' loading state indefinitely even after 8s wait. Likely because no game with id=1 exists on the deployed contract OR the on-chain read is silently failing (no error UI, no timeout fallback). Should show a 'game not found' or empty/error state instead of perpetual loader.

action_items: Optional: add a not-found / error fallback on /game/:id when contract read returns empty / throws, instead of perpetual 'LOADING NEURAL LINK...' state
Optional: investigate the 7 HTTP 413 console errors on home page (likely WalletConnect verify-api or RPC payload). Doesn't block app, but pollutes console.

OG image endpoint successfully renders ~200KB PNG via @resvg/resvg-js, content-type and PNG magic header valid.
Share page contains all required Open Graph + Twitter card meta tags and http-equiv refresh fallback.
Frontend wagmi config relies on WalletConnect projectId from .env - present in /app/artifacts/rps-game/.env.
No data-testid on most interactive elements (acknowledged - external repo) - low priority.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_neon_rps_api.py - covers /api/healthz, /api/health (node_api flag), /api/og/game/1 (PNG validation), /api/share/g/1 (OG meta + refresh). All pass. Frontend Vite app served at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL root. /game/:id rendering depends on on-chain game existence - if contract has no games, page shows loading indefinitely. Use https://5f994dc7-8c00-4d58-a02b-665468237121.preview.emergentagent.com as base URL (frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL was empty).
rca of the issue: /game/1 perpetual loading: the GameDetail component (in /app/artifacts/rps-game/src/) likely awaits a viem useReadContract call for game id 1. If that game doesn't exist on the deployed contract (0x2F2e...7AAD on Base mainnet), the read returns zero/empty struct but the component's loading guard probably never flips to false. Mitigation: in the component, treat 'game data with player1 == zero address' as 'not found' and render an empty/error UI; also add a timeout fallback.
